reason: DPsurv combines Gaussian mixture model slide embeddings with evidential neural networks on frozen UNI2-h features.
CogniMap3D builds on the VGGT/DINOv2 backbone and LoFTR attention matching, and encodes point clouds with a modified PointNet++.
Prism adds a three-layer 1D-CNN confounder encoder to a Caduceus backbone, which the text groups with Mamba and HyenaDNA.
Profile2Gen trains CTGAN, TVAE, DDPM, normalizing flows and a Bayesian network as generators.
NeurAlign trains volumetric and spherical registration networks (with a VoxelMorph base), but the text never names their family.
NeuralCohort uses graph propagation over a patient adjacency matrix and an encoder-decoder, plugged into ClinicalBERT, Med2Vec and MiME backbones.
AANet trains contrastive pocket/ligand encoders (family not named) and a cross-attention adapter that aggregates candidate cavities.
The authors pretrain ResNet-50 and CLIP, adapt the PLIP vision-language model and fine-tune PubMedBERT.
CRAFT is applied to an EEGNet-style CNN with LSTMs, a 3D SFCN CNN and a ResNet50 with an attention head.
The paper uses MLP probes on frozen Boltz2 features, a diffusion GruM model with a Pairformer attention denoiser and graph-transformer SynFlowNet policies.
The student model fine-tunes an ESM2-650M encoder, a BERT-size protein language model rather than a GPT/Llama-scale LLM.
APM is a flow-matching model whose trunk stacks IPA and Transformer-encoder structure modules, with an ESM protein language model.
The study benchmarks pretrained and untrained vision backbones and geometric encoders (DINOv2, MAE), but this text names no family.
TinyMIG trains a U-shaped segmentation network with a ResNet-34 encoder distilled from SAM/DINOv2 teachers, whose family is not named.
HandEdit trains no model; its metric suite includes VLM-based judgment, and SAM3/ProPainter are used only in data curation.
TTA trains prototypes, projections and an OT module on frozen UNI or ResNet50 features, but never names the family of its own encoders.
The only named mechanisms in GDNet are cross-attention in the detail encoder and MLP fusion; CNNs appear only in related work.
ProSpero uses EvoDiff, which the text describes as a ByteNet-style CNN, and an ensemble of 1D CNN surrogates; ESM-2 appears only in baselines.
H2DiLR learns vector-quantized neural codes with shared and private codebooks (VQ-VAE style tokenizers) for masked pretraining.
dMoE adds MLP expert layers to TransUNet (ViT-B) and a 3D Residual U-Net backbone.
